How this editor works

Drag a block into the canvas, select text or images to edit them, and use Desktop, Tablet and Phone views to check your layout. Save keeps the draft in your account. Preview shows your current edits. Review & publish creates a public page from the saved revision. Later edits stay private until you publish again. Unpublish removes the public page and keeps the draft.

Published pages support text, images, layout and ordinary links. Scripts, embedded apps and form submissions are disabled. Use the Storefront module for product enquiries and the main business website.
